top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Special Diets - Written Approval from Physician or Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3311(a)(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children enrolled have diet restrictions without medical documentation on file.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPSC form was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under two were watching television.

top_violation_types.title: Policies for Release of Children (26 TAC §747.3903(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, the primary caregiver has not been following procedures for release of children at pick up time and identifications are not checked as needed.

top_violation_types.title: Water Temperature (26 TAC §747.3219)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The hot water temperature for the restroom used by children exceeded 120 degrees.
